item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a strong independent 2024 audit that directly traces Modi’s claimed policy goals to end-user outcomes across jobs, nutrition, health, and rural welfare. The positive side is dominated by macro aggregates and government self-reports; the negative side is more concrete on rural distress, food inflation, and security breakdowns. So the best-supported reading is: 2024 showed some macro improvement and administrative scaling, but the lived outcomes that matter for the public were mixed at best and in some areas clearly worse.","evidence":[{"title":"FY 2023-24 real GDP grew 8.2%","publisher":"Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation / PIB","date":"31 May 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2022323&lang=2&reg=3","summary":"Strong positive macro outcome. This is mainly official self-reporting, but it does show measurable implementation.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6"]},{"title":"BJP lost many rural constituencies amid jobs and inflation concerns","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"7 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/rural-vote-fall-cost-indias-modi-a-decisive-election-win/2121496/","summary":"Negative outcome signal.
